note: App-owned. Hand-edited. The server never writes this file. Every entry in a pillar's roles[] and every signature chain is validated against the live roster at request time; anything that does not resolve renders as a visible warning rather than being dropped.

personas.name: Trades and field service
personas.tagline: Quotes out the same day, invoices that do not sit in the ute for a fortnight.
personas.blurb: You win work on the tools and lose it in the paperwork. This shape of the OS takes the quote, the follow-up, and the invoice off your night shift, and keeps every job's history in one project so the next quote starts from what the last one taught you.
personas.north_star: Days from site visit to invoice sent

pillars.name: Win the job
pillars.note: The enquiry becomes a researched quote with a real angle, not a number guessed at 9pm.

pillars.name: Get paid
pillars.note: How invoicing actually runs: who raises it, when it chases, what happens at 30 days.

pillars.name: Answer the phone
pillars.note: The calls that come while you are up a ladder stop going to voicemail.

pillars.name: Be findable
pillars.note: A site that says what you do, where you work, and how to book you.

pillars.name: Run the crew
pillars.note: The way you do a job written down once, so a new pair of hands does it your way.

tools: A mobile phone that rings too much

signature.why: Site visit Monday, quote Monday night, follow-up Thursday, invoice on completion. One project holds the client's whole story, so the third job for the same customer starts from the first two.

personas.name: Clinic and allied health
personas.tagline: The front desk stops being the bottleneck between a full book and an empty one.
personas.blurb: Your practitioners are the product and the admin is the tax. This shape puts the enquiry handling, the intake paperwork, and the patient-facing explanations into roles that run the same way every time, and keeps the clinical judgement exactly where it belongs, with you.

pillars.name: Fill the book
pillars.note: New enquiries answered in your voice, booked, and reminded.

pillars.name: Explain the care
pillars.note: The handouts and FAQs patients actually read, written once and reused.

pillars.name: Keep the practice compliant
pillars.note: Policies and consent language kept current, with the review points named.

pillars.name: Grow the practitioners
pillars.note: Onboarding and skills growth for a team that turns over.

pillars.name: Watch the money
pillars.note: The monthly numbers read to you, not left in the accounting software.

signature.why: Every enquiry and complaint gets triaged, the patterns get summarised, the top questions become the FAQ, and the process that caused them gets fixed. The front desk stops answering the same question for the four hundredth time.

personas.name: Marketing agency
personas.tagline: Ten retainers on a small team, without a ball dropped on the tenth.
personas.blurb: You sell attention and you have none left for your own operation. This shape runs the pitch, the delivery, and the handover as named roles, so the work that wins a client is the same work that keeps them.
personas.north_star: Retained monthly revenue kept, not just won

pillars.name: New business
pillars.note: Research, brief, proposal. The pitch built on evidence, not adjectives.

pillars.name: Client delivery
pillars.note: Campaign to assets to review, one project per client.

pillars.name: Keep the voice
pillars.note: Everything that ships checked against the client's voice, not yours.

pillars.name: Prove the value
pillars.note: The handover and the playbook that make renewal a formality.

pillars.name: Agency ops
pillars.note: Your own pipeline and margin, reviewed on a rhythm.

signature.chain: Chain 11: Client delivery, start to finish
signature.why: The prospect brief becomes the proposal, the proposal becomes the handover, the handover becomes the client playbook. Four documents that agree with each other because each one read the last.

personas.name: Real estate team
personas.tagline: Every listing gets the campaign the flagship listing gets.
personas.blurb: Your best campaign and your quietest one should not be different jobs. This shape makes the listing campaign a repeatable run, and keeps the vendor updates and the appraisal follow-ups from depending on which day of the week it is.

pillars.name: Win the listing
pillars.note: The appraisal presentation and the follow-up that comes after it.

pillars.name: Launch the campaign
pillars.note: Plan, social pack, email, landing page. Same standard on every property.

pillars.name: Show the property
pillars.note: The immersive listing page that makes a scroll feel like a walk-through.

pillars.name: Keep the vendor informed
pillars.note: The weekly update written from what actually happened at the open.

pillars.name: Run the office
pillars.note: New agents onboarded to your process, not to their last agency's.

tools: A CRM with too many stale contacts

signature.why: One angle chosen at the plan step is inherited by the socials, the email, and the landing page, because all four run inside the same project. The campaign reads as one campaign.

personas.name: Hospitality and venue
personas.tagline: The feed keeps running on the weeks you are too flat out to post.
personas.blurb: Your marketing happens when service allows, which is never. This shape turns one good shoot or one good week into a month of posts, keeps the function enquiries answered, and gets the staff trained the same way every intake.

pillars.name: Feed the feed
pillars.note: One asset becomes a month. Repurpose first, create second.

pillars.name: Fill the room
pillars.note: Bookings, functions, and the enquiries that arrive at 11pm.

pillars.name: Be found locally
pillars.note: The page that ranks for your suburb and your dish.

pillars.name: Train the floor
pillars.note: Service standards written down, taught the same way to every intake.

pillars.name: Mind the margin
pillars.note: Where the money went, monthly, in words you can act on.

signature.why: One shoot, repurposed into a social pack, an email, and a voice check. The month is done in an afternoon and it all sounds like the venue, not like a template.

personas.name: Professional services
personas.tagline: The advice is yours. The month-end assembly is not.
personas.blurb: You bill for judgement and spend your week assembling the inputs to it. This shape runs the recurring money work, the client reporting, and the proposals, and leaves the call with the client exactly where it should be.
personas.north_star: Billable hours as a share of the week

pillars.name: The monthly run
pillars.note: Expenses, summary, cashflow, invoicing. Same order, every month.

pillars.name: Report to the client
pillars.note: The numbers turned into a document a business owner can act on.

pillars.name: Win the next engagement
pillars.note: Scoped proposals that name the deliverable and the boundary.

pillars.name: Systemise the practice
pillars.note: The work you repeat, mapped and then automated where it is safe to.

pillars.name: Stay defensible
pillars.note: Policies, engagement terms, and compliance checks kept current.

signature.why: Expenses read first so the summary knows what moved, the summary feeds the cashflow brief, and the invoicing workflow closes the loop. An hour a month per client instead of a day.
